subject: Annual planning: decision radar & scenario modeling kickoff
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual planning: decision radar & scenario modeling kickoff

Team —

Time to start the annual planning loop. I want us to focus on two tight deliverables over the next 3 weeks: a decision radar (what decisions we need to make + timing) and three scenario models (base / downside / upside) that map targets to capacity and cost. Goal: have an aligned ask to Finance and an internal deck for the May QBR prep.

Immediate asks:
- Please download the attached decision_radar_template.xlsx and add your top 6 strategic decisions by Friday 4/23. Mark owner, decision date, and dependencies.
- Markus: can you lead the scenario model (cost/latency tradeoffs)? I dropped a starter CSV (scenario_cost_model.csv).
- Lauren: pull high-level targets (revenue/ARR growth bands) and any product asks that drive capacity.
- Maya: add any security/compliance guardrails that affect pricing or timeline.
- Tessa: consolidate QBR checklist and slot a 90-minute working session the week of 4/25 for the leadership team.

I'll collect inputs and circulate a combined view. We should be ruthless about keeping the radar to decisions we can reasonably commit to in this cycle.

Attachments: decision_radar_template.xlsx, scenario_cost_model.csv

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning: decision radar & scenario modeling kickoff

Vivek —

Thanks, this is helpful. I populated the template with an initial pass (see attached). My early priorities:
- FY28 ARR target bands (conservative / target / aggressive) + top GTM bets tied to each band.
- Pricing levers (volume discounts / committed tiers) that we can roll out in H1.
- Product roadmap asks that require Dedicated & Private capacity work.

Notes:
- I included a row for a possible pricing experiment for Reserved capacity credits that Sales has requested.
- We should flag any decisions that require legal/procurement lead time (I tagged those).

Attached: decision_radar_filled_LB.xlsx

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
GM, Growth & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning: decision radar & scenario modeling kickoff

Vivek / team —

I started the scenario_cost_model.csv with three levers: average tokens/sec throughput per GPU, KV-cache hit rate assumptions, and quantization/instance mix. For each scenario I modeled implied GPU months and a unit cost estimate. Early findings: small drop in latency-conscious throughput (5–8%) buys ~12% cost reduction via 4-bit quantization on certain models — but we need to validate end-to-end quality.

Requests:
- Ops: can we run a quick benchmark on the Llama-2-extended variant with quantization profile Q4 to validate perf/cost curve?
- Finance (cc external): Morgan, could you confirm how we should present committed capacity vs. on-demand cost in the QBR (monthly breakouts vs. annualized)?

Attachments: scenario_cost_model.csv

-Markus
Head of Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@cloudbox.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Annual planning: decision radar & scenario modeling kickoff

Markus / Lauren —

Appreciate the early visibility. A few clarifying questions from Finance:
1) If you present committed capacity, our FP&A will want monthly burn + expected utilization bands per quarter.
2) For discounts/commits, can you provide a short sensitivity table showing 3 commit tiers and the expected payback?
3) We need a high-level ask by 5/6 to include in CloudBox's vendor budgeting cycle.

I can join the working session week of 4/25 as needed — happy to sync.

Best,
Morgan Lee
Director, Strategic Finance
CloudBox (partner & early Redwood customer)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, markus.klein@markus.klein@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning: decision radar & scenario modeling kickoff

All — quick note: I compiled the QBR prep checklist and slid a 90-min working session on 2027-04-29 09:30–11:00 PT (invite sent). Attached is the QBR checklist and a draft deck outline.

Attachments: qbr_prep_checklist.pdf

Tessa
Head of Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, markus.klein@markus.klein@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: morgan.lee@cloudbox.com
Date: Mon, 02 May 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning: decision radar & scenario modeling kickoff — alignment and next steps

Thanks for the quick turn. Summary / decisions we can commit to now:
- Owners update decision_radar_template.xlsx by EOD 5/6. (Lauren: targets; Markus: validated cost curves; Maya: compliance guardrails; Tessa: finalize QBR deck outline.)
- Finance ask: Morgan, we'll provide month-by-month committed vs. on-demand sensitivity table by 5/6 (Markus + Lauren to lead).
- Working session outcome: agree on 3 target bands and the decision dates we surface in the QBR.

Next steps:
- I'll consolidate inputs into the shared folder (link below) and circulate a 1-pager for SLT review on 5/9. Please flag anything you cannot meet by 5/6 now so we can reassign.

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bDecisionRadar
Deck draft: https://docs.redwood.com/board/annual-planning-2027

Thanks — let’s keep this tight.

Vivek
VP, Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference
